issues.title: لا يمكن إكمال معايرة R0 التلقائية من الإعدادات
issues.evidence: Screenshot 1 (2026-10-31): repeating IllegalArgumentException on R0 polling, and MQ2 source=unavailable / recorded R0 samples=0
issues.actual: Auto R0 fails to progress/commit; user sees IllegalArgumentException class only
issues.expected: Calibrate 180 s warmup + 60 s acquisition, inspect 8 channels, explicit accept/save NVS and Android R0
issues.root_cause: CONFIRMED installed ESP32-Tank 0.1.4-v4-dev (TANK-V4-ECHO-CALIBRATION-CANDIDATE, API4) emits /r0 schema tank-r0-fw-v4/1; Android V7 FirmwareR0Contract.progress accepts only tank-r0-fw-v5/2, tank-r0-fw-v6/1 and tank-r0-fw-v6/2, immediately throwing IllegalArgumentException('Unsupported firmware R0 API schema'). Independent semantic incompatibility: V4 firmware computes Rs_air/legacy cleanAir sensor-specific factor and immediately persists NVS, whereas V6 quick computes mean Rs_air and uses staged operator accept before NVS commit. V4 supports 180+60 in its calibrationStart (300+60 is default), so duration mismatch is not the sole/direct cause.
issues.diagnostic_hypothesis: FirmwareR0Contract.progress() rejects ESP32 /r0 payload; exact reason cannot be determined from screenshot because V7 hides exception message
issues.source_change: 2678773e724faefb18338aa6d54a225eb80610eb exposes exception message and /r0 schema/timing in UI; diagnostic only; not yet tested
issues.next_evidence: Owner-supplied /diag and /r0 conclusively identify V4. On approved firmware upgrade, validate /diag V6 quick, /r0 at idle/warmup/sampling/pending/ready, source mean Rs, all eight >=10 samples, NVS committed and smartphone R0 stored. Keep older NVS intact unless explicit approved migration.
issues.validation: Require actual V6-device R0 8-channel committed readback and phone persistence without losing existing stored R0
issues.resolution_scope: V8 operator R0 UI and protocol compatibility diagnostics rebuilt; actual V7 IllegalArgumentException source still not reproducible without device /r0 response
issues.ci_conclusion: V8 Android screen rebuild compiled and unit-tested on run 41158316938; does NOT establish compatibility with still-installed V4 hardware.
issues.confirmed_firmware_source_finding: V6 /r0 can report tank-r0-fw-v5/2 while idle without stored quick calibration, then v6/2 for warmup/sampling/pending/ready; this version transition is valid and requires state-aware validation.
issues.note: A successful compile and source-unit test is not evidence that the owner device reproduces or resolves the bug; stage remains REPORTED pending /r0 capture and bench validation.

device_evidence.source: Live robot /diag and /r0 JSON explicitly supplied by owner 2026-10-31

issues.required_solution: Upgrade ESP32 main firmware to qualified V6 quick-R0 baseline for 180s warmup + 60s measurement, staged approval and NVS verified commit. This is NOT downgrading the Android app. Keep app V8. Never treat V4 graph-scaled R0 as V6 device mean Rs_air. Before release, compile/flash matching firmware, verify /diag reports V6 and /r0 schema v6/2 during active quick calibration, plus eight samples/counts and NVS/phone readback. Check legacy NVS migration; do not assume preexisting V4 R0 is usable as V6. ESP32-CAM firmware need not change for this issue.
source_observations: Android V7  b344b8ac: FirmwareR0Contract.progress schema guard rejects tank-r0-fw-v4/1 before timing or channel checks.
V4 branch Hardware.cpp calibrationStart accepts any warmSeconds <=3600 and sampleSeconds within [1,3600], but original web default warm=300,sample=60.
V4 branch Hardware.cpp calibrationUpdate uses calSum[i]/calCount[i]/cleanAir[i], writes record directly via saveR0Record and returns CAL_READY, no CAL_PENDING.
V4 ESP32-Tank.ino /r0 has start and cancel only, no accept handler.
V6 source uses V6_180S_WARM_60S_SINGLE_RS_AIR, clean-air Rs mean, pending candidate and explicit accept/readback.
